name: Galaxy Note Edge

images.credit: GadgetsGuy, CC BY 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 4.4.4 "KitKat", First major update: Android 5.0.1 "Lollipop", Second major update: Android 5.1.1 "Lollipop", Current: Android 6.0.1 "Marshmallow", Custom: Android 11
Platform.Chipset: Samsung Exynos 5 Octa 5433 (South Korea version), Qualcomm Snapdragon 805 (international version)
Platform.CPU: Quad-core 1.3 GHz Cortex-A53 & quad-core 1.9 GHz Cortex-A57 (South Korea version), 2.7 GHz Krait 450 quad-core (international version)
Platform.GPU: ARM Mali T760 GPU (South Korea version), Adreno 420 (international version)

Display.Display: 142 mm (5.6 in) Super AMOLED 524 ppi 2560×1600 16:10 aspect ratio

Cameras.Rear camera: 16-megapixel BSI, with autofocus, 2160p (4K) at 30fps (limited to 5 mins), 1440p at 30fps, 1080p at 30/60fps, 720p at 30/60fps, slo-mo video recording at 720p at 120fps

Battery.Charging: Qualcomm Quick Charge 2.0 at 15 W, Qi wireless charging requires special back cover
